store.summary: Native AP, PCAP capture, TLS and live traffic research
store.description: Native keyboard controls for a WPA2 research AP with wired WAN, isolated clients, bounded PCAP and metadata logs, SSLsplit with local or validated custom CAs, twelve exact recovered lab profiles, Android and Burp exports, and owned rollback. Native C0 framebuffer/Fn keyboard and real-client operation are device-tested; concurrent two-station isolation is the sole waived acceptance proof. Simulator mode is explicit.
